caption_top_osiris_procession.name: Osiris N.

descriptions.default: "Osiris N., justified." The deceased, at the head of the procession arriving in the field.

caption_top_osiris_procession.reference: Backes TBP; placement is my reading

caption_top_great_ennead.name: The Great Ennead

descriptions.default: "The Great Ennead." The three seated gods are the company of the gods, waiting to be fed.

caption_top_great_ennead.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 (same label in P. Ryerson)

caption_top_rowing.name: Rowing

descriptions.default: "Rowing in the waters of Hotep."

caption_top_rowing.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 has "paddling in Hotep's lake"

descriptions.default: "Osiris N., justified." The deceased sits in the boat.
"Osiris N., justified." The deceased holds out an offering.

caption_top_hotep_falcon.name: Hotep

descriptions.default: "Hotep, the great god, lord of the sky." The falcon on the shrine is Hotep, lord of the Field of Offerings.

caption_top_hotep_falcon.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 (falcon named the same in P. Ryerson)

caption_top_horizon_gods.name: The gods of the horizon

descriptions.default: "The gods of the horizon."

caption_top_horizon_gods.reference: Backes TBP; that it labels the mummiform god is my reading

caption_top_oval_no_sweat.name: A place in the field

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "There is no sweat".

caption_top_oval_no_sweat.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 reads the matching Ryerson oval as Hetpet; which oval is my guess

caption_top_oval_qenqenet.name: Qenqenet

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: Qenqenet, "the beating place."

caption_top_oval_qenqenet.reference: Backes TBP ("Schlage-Stätte"); Allen 1960 (Qnqnt); which oval is my guess

caption_top_oval_great_town.name: The Great Town

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "the Great Town."

caption_top_oval_great_town.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "City of the Great One"

caption_top_being_hotep.name: Being Hotep

descriptions.default: "Being Hotep in the fields of the foremost ones."

caption_top_being_hotep.reference: Backes TBP ("Vorderen" marked uncertain); Allen 1960 Ryerson: "Existing as Hotep, lord of the fields, with breath in his nose"

caption_mid_ploughing.name: Ploughing

descriptions.default: "Ploughing the sky along its length." The field is as long as the sky.

caption_mid_ploughing.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "plowing" in a region "the length of which is (the length of) the sky"

caption_mid_oval_knife.name: A place in the field

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "Knife Place". The name is written with a knife alone.

caption_mid_oval_knife.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 notes the oval written with knife alone, which CT calls "Lady of the Two Lands"

caption_mid_oval_flourishing.name: A place in the field

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "the Flourishing One."

caption_mid_oval_flourishing.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "the Verdant"; which oval is my guess

caption_mid_oval_great_green.name: The Great Green

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "the Great Green."

caption_mid_oval_great_green.reference: Backes TBP (first word unread); Allen 1960 "Ring of the Sea" (?); which oval is my guess

caption_mid_oval_hotep.name: A place in the field

descriptions.default: A place of the field, named in an oval: "Hotep" or "Food," followed by a knife (uncertain reading).

caption_mid_oval_hotep.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "the Peaceful"; which oval is my guess

caption_mid_hippo_lake.name: The Opening of the Hippopotamus

descriptions.default: "The Opening of the Hippopotamus. Its length is a thousand leagues; its breadth cannot be told. There are no fish in it, no islands in it, no snakes in it."

caption_mid_hippo_lake.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "lake of the hippopotamus ... no fish, no snakes, and no plants"

caption_mid_overflow.name: Giving the overflow

descriptions.default: "Giving the overflow." The deceased presents the flood's abundance.

caption_mid_overflow.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "presenting the overflow"; placement is my reading

descriptions.default: "Osiris N., justified."

caption_mid_hapi.name: Hapi

descriptions.default: "Hapi, father of the gods." The enthroned god is the Inundation.

caption_mid_hapi.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "the Inundation, father of the gods"; the archived level.json calls him Hetep

caption_bot_blessed.name: The place of the blessed

descriptions.default: "The place of the blessed. They are seven cubits tall; the emmer is three cubits, and it is the worthy ones who reap it."

caption_bot_blessed.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 Ryerson: "Seat of the blessed. (The height of its barley) is 7 cubits, its stalk(s) 3 cubits. It is the blameless mummy that reaps them."

caption_bot_island_re.name: The god in it

descriptions.default: "The god in it: Re."

caption_bot_island_re.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 Ryerson: "the birthplace of the god. This city is Qenqenet. The God who is in it is Re"; placement is my reading

caption_bot_birthplace.name: Birthplace of the gods

descriptions.default: "Birthplace of the gods ... a blameless thing."

caption_bot_birthplace.reference: Backes TBP (middle words unread, "der im Wüten ist" uncertain); placement is my reading

caption_bot_three_gods.name: Shu, Tefnut and Geb

descriptions.default: "Those who belong to the ones who made it. Shu, Tefnut, Geb."

caption_bot_three_gods.reference: Backes TBP (first line marked uncertain); Allen 1960 Ryerson: "(they) who eat it: Shu, Tefnut, and Geb"

caption_bot_throne_bark.name: The bark of Wennefer

descriptions.default: "Destroying, Driving Away" (uncertain reading): the name of the bark with the throne. "The god in it: Wennefer."

caption_bot_throne_bark.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 Ryerson: "the holy throne; the god who occupies it is Unnofer"; split between this line and the column beside it is my reading

caption_bot_great_food.name: Great Food

descriptions.default: "The place of Great Food."

caption_bot_great_food.reference: Backes TBP; placement is my reading

caption_bot_rehorakhty_bark.name: The bark of Re-Harakhty

descriptions.default: "The bark of Re-Harakhty when he crosses to the Field of Reeds."

caption_bot_rehorakhty_bark.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 Ryerson: "the bark of Re-Harakhte when he crosses to the Field of Rush(es)"

caption_bot_destroying_water.name: The Destroying One

descriptions.default: "The Destroying One": a stretch of water.

caption_bot_destroying_water.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 has an uncertain legend above the two barks, possibly "disturbing the water"

caption_bot_oval_slaughter.name: Slaughter

descriptions.default: An island of the field, named in an oval: "Slaughter."

caption_bot_oval_slaughter.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 reads the Ryerson ovals as Dpf(?)t, Hz't, the Powerful, the United; which oval is my guess

caption_bot_oval_food.name: Food

descriptions.default: An island of the field, named in an oval: "Food."

caption_bot_oval_food.reference: Backes TBP; which oval is my guess

caption_bot_oval_strong.name: The Strong One

descriptions.default: An island of the field, named in an oval: "the Strong One."

caption_bot_oval_strong.reference: Backes TBP; Allen 1960 "the Powerful"; which oval is my guess

caption_bot_oval_nehet.name: The waters of Nehet

descriptions.default: A water of the field, named in an oval: "the waters of Nehet."

caption_bot_oval_nehet.reference: Backes TBP; which oval is my guess

caption_bot_heron_island.name: The island with the bird

descriptions.default: An island ringed by water, its name written with a single bird: perhaps "the common folk."

caption_bot_heron_island.reference: Allen 1960 (Ryerson's lower-left pool, "rḫyt", marked uncertain); not in Backes TBP's list
